text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Kawalan Bekalan

(Barang-Barang Kawalan) (No. 4) 2024.

Barang-barang kawalan

2. Barang-barang yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual diisytiharkan sebagai

barang-barang kawalan bagi tempoh mulai 27 Mei 2024 hingga 4 Jun 2024.

JADUAL

BARANG-BARANG KAWALAN

1. Daging kerbau import (India) (tidak termasuk bahagian batang pinang)

2. Kepak ayam

3. Kubis bulat import (Indonesia dan China, tidak termasuk kubis Beijing)

4. Babi hidup

5. Daging babi (perut)

6. Daging babi (daging dan lemak)

Dibuat 16 Mei 2024

[KPDN(PGK)(S)0.5001/4 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/JLD.14]

 DATUK ARMIZAN BIN MOHD ALI

Menteri Perdagangan Dalam Negeri dan Kos Sara Hidup

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES ACT 1961

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES (CONTROLLED ARTICLES) (NO. 4) ORDER 2024

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of

the Control of Supplies Act 1961 [Act 122], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the Control of Supplies (Controlled Articles)

(No. 4) Order 2024.

Controlled articles

2. The articles specified in the Schedule are declared to be controlled articles

for the period from 27 May 2024 to 4 June 2024.

SCHEDULE

CONTROLLED ARTICLES

1. Imported buffalo meat (India) (not including tenderloin)

2. Chicken wing

3. Imported round cabbage (Indonesia and China, not including

Beijing cabbage)

4. Live pig

5. Pork (belly)

6. Pork (lean and fat)

Made 16 May 2024

[KPDN(PGK)(S)0.5001/4 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/JLD.14]

 DATUK ARMIZAN BIN MOHD ALI

Minister of Domestic Trade and Cost of Living
